stem_book: Find the values of p, q, r: (i) A quadratic equation x² + 7x + 10 = 0 and p, q are roots of equation and r is sum of roots. Value of p, q, r = ? (ii) A quadratic equation x² + 2x + 7 = 0 and px² + qx + r = 0 have a root common then values of p, q, r (smallest integral values) = ? (iii) A quadratic equation 4x² + 5x + 1 = 0 have p is leading coefficient, q is discriminant and Range is [r, ∞). Value of p, q, r = ?
reason: Three-part recap table, each part with three separate blanks; manifest split it into 3 entries sharing one code.
work: (ii) D = 4 − 28 < 0 ⇒ both roots common ⇒ p:q:r = 1:2:7; (iii) D = 25 − 16 = 9, min = −D/4a = −9/16
